adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts`, when credential sync is enabled it calls `fetch(process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT, { method: "POST", body: ... })` without any `AbortSignal`/timeout handling. Node/undici `fetch` has no default timeout, so a hung/unresponsive sync endpoint can block the refresh path until the surrounding request/runtime times out. This is a concrete robustness/availability concern introduced by the new sync path, but not a strictly deterministic correctness failure in the diff itself.
